script:
So, you know how AI is just like us but better. Well, it's actually way more complicated than that.

Did you know that the first AI program was created in 1951? It was called Logical Theorist and could solve a puzzle by itself. Talk about ahead of its time.

Today, there are over 100 billion parameters in a typical AI model. That's like having 100 million calculators all solving math problems at the same time.

And get this, AI can learn from scratch in just a few hours. Some models are even better than humans at recognizing images and speech. No wonder Siri and Alexa sound so cool.

But here's the thing, AI is only as good as the data it was trained on. If it's fed fake information, it'll spit out fake results. That's why trust in AI is growing more important every day.

The future of AI is looking bright, but we need to be careful about how we use it. We don't want AI to become smarter than us just yet.
